caption:
Q2 FY27 closes September 30. Headcount decisions and mid-year reviews are landing in the same fortnight as reporting on 25,000
come to 35,000 projected Indian IT job losses 
across every seniority level, not just entry.

Here is what the spreadsheets don't show. When a restructuring list is drawn up, leadership keeps the people it can name and characterise without checking a file. The ones whose position in the last hard meeting is remembered. The ones with a voice attached to a decision.

If your ideas have been getting credited to the louder person in the room, that isn't a bruised ego problem anymore. It's a visibility problem with consequences attached.

In command, you learn that bearing and tone are not decoration. They are how your judgement becomes attributable to you. Speak at the weight of your rank. Hold the pause. Let your name sit on the recommendation before someone else's does.
